<observations>
Date: Jul 15 - Jul 21, 2026 (Summary of Past Context)
* 🔴 User profile: Graphic designer downtown (wfh Thu/Fri), vegetarian 4+ years, sleeps exactly 7 hours/night, has a torn left knee meniscus, and has never had a cardiac stress test. Owns a Garmin Forerunner 265 (resting HR 52 bpm).
* 🔴 Training & Lifestyle: Prefers outdoor running over treadmills, coconut water over sports drinks, black coffee pre-long run, Merino wool socks, and listens to indie rock. Uses Nike Pegasus shoes (45 miles). Takes nightly magnesium. Walks golden retriever in evenings.
* ✅ Jul 15-21 training logs, weather tracking, recovery protocols, and weekly mileage adjustments (28 miles) successfully completed.

Date: Jul 24, 2026
* 🔴 User stated half marathon is September 4, 2026 (6 weeks out); refuses to run with headphones on busy streets; eats whole-wheat pasta the night before hard workouts.
* 🟢 User asked about electrolytes for hot-weather pacing, water bottle replacements, and swimming cross-training.
* 🟡 Agent retrieved sodium loss estimates and swimming metrics.
* ✅ Weekly training schedule updated.

Date: Jul 28, 2026
* 🔴 User prefers high-density foam rollers, refuses bouncing waist packs during tempo runs, and eats steel-cut oats with blueberries on high-mileage mornings.
* 🟢 User asked about foam rolling for calves, compression socks, waterproof gym bags, and stationary bike recovery workouts.
* 🟡 Agent checked gear reviews, compression pressure ratings, and cycling cadence metrics.
* ✅ Recovery schedule updated.

Date: Aug 1, 2026
* 🔴 User strongly dislikes static stretching before morning track sessions, refuses neon apparel for early morning road runs, and drinks lemon-infused coconut water post-long run.
* 🟢 User asked about hamstring vs. quad stretching, hot-weather hydration temperature, swimming cross-training, and replacement running caps.
* 🟡 Agent analyzed flexibility scores, calculated electrolyte absorption rates, and searched for dark moisture-wicking caps.
* ✅ Monthly training log updated with cross-training and nutrition notes.
</observations>
